item: A-026: a memory-declined rollup no longer re-asks its verdicts on every served read
summary: Audit P12 / A-026, verified on main: while the rollup was declined for memory, every Home/Insights read that found no rollup started a build thread that ran the start-time verdicts, declined again and logged an INFO line. Now the serve paths wait 30 s after a memory decline (memory guard or affordability) before asking again: measured 200 reads -> 200 verdict runs before, 1 after. Hold and last-build declines are not gated (a released hold is seen at once). Each verdict run costs about 0.4 ms here, so the gain is the threads and log lines, not CPU.
